item.title: BitSlug 1.0.0
item.description:
🚀 Release Notes – v1.0.0

We're excited to introduce the first official release of Unofficial Bitrise Client — a modern, native macOS application to monitor and manage your Bitrise projects with ease.

✨ Main Points

  • Build Monitoring – Keep track of your Bitrise builds in real time, with live status updates.
  • Pipeline Management – View and manage your pipelines directly from the macOS app.
  • Workflow Control – Trigger, stop, and manage workflows without leaving your desktop.
  • Native macOS Experience – Enjoy a sleek, fast, and lightweight interface designed specifically for macOS.
  • Secure Authentication – Connect safely to your Bitrise account.
  • Project Overview – Quickly access builds, logs, and essential project details in one place.

🌐 Read more

For more information, visit: bitslug-org.github.io
